changelog:
0.9.9

  • Fixed a counter that would never settle: when a visit was moved between
    • buckets by the periodic re-check, the good-bot total changed but the per-engine counters did not. Each move left a permanent gap in the split, so on a long-running site the "before the split" line could never reach zero. The engine counter now moves with the bucket.
  • On a fresh install there is nothing to carry over, so that line never
appears at all.
